description: Synthetic support messages for comparing zero-shot and few-shot intent classification. The few-shot examples and evaluation examples are separate.
task_instruction: Classify each support message as exactly one of: Billing, IT, or Fraud. Return only the category name.

labels.Billing: Recognized charges, invoices, subscriptions, plans, payments, or refund requests.
labels.IT: Software, hardware, network, setup, or account-access problems that prevent a service or feature from working.
labels.Fraud: Suspected unauthorized transactions, scams, phishing, identity misuse, or account changes the customer did not make.

few_shot_examples.input: I changed to the monthly plan last week, but I was charged for a full year.
Please send me an invoice that includes my company tax number.
The desktop app closes every time I try to open a report.
My files have been stuck syncing since I installed the latest update.
I see a card purchase from a store I have never used, and I did not make it.
Someone claiming to be support asked for my verification code, and now there is an account change I did not make.

evaluation_examples.input: My card was charged twice for this month's subscription.
I cancelled before the renewal date but still see a renewal charge.
The payment page says my payment failed, but the money has left my bank account.
I was charged after my free trial ended and would like to request a refund.
Where can I download receipts for the last three payments?
The discount was not applied to my latest invoice.
The export button spins for a while and then gives me a blank file.
I cannot pair the app with my device even though Bluetooth is enabled.
The app freezes whenever I open the settings page.
I followed the setup guide, but the desktop installer stops with error 104.
Notifications stopped appearing after I updated the mobile app.
The search results never finish loading, even after restarting the browser.
There is a card transaction from a merchant I do not recognize, and I did not authorize it.
I got a text with a link asking me to confirm my card PIN, and now I see a purchase I did not make.
Someone called pretending to be support, asked for my one-time code, and then changed my account email.
A wire transfer left my account, but I did not send or approve it.
My card was added to a mobile wallet on a phone I do not own, and there is a charge I did not make.
My recovery email and mailing address were changed, but I did not make those changes.
